Steak and Butter Gal.bio: Real-food carnivore on a real budget. Known for Costco hauls, practical meal prep, and cutting through the expensive cuts myth. One of the most practical voices in the space.

Anthony Chaffee MD.bio: Neurosurgical resident turned carnivore advocate. Makes the case for animal-based eating from a hard science angle — no hedging, no nuance theater. One of the most cited voices on carnivore and neurological health.

KenDBerryMD.bio: Tennessee family physician who went carnivore after decades of conventional medicine advice didn't work for his patients — or himself. Practical, plain-spoken, and not afraid to call out bad nutritional science.

Shawn Baker MD.bio: Orthopedic surgeon, former world record powerlifter, and the closest thing the carnivore movement has to a founding father. Author of The Carnivore Diet. Still lifts. Still only eats meat.

Laura Spath.bio: Down-to-earth carnivore content covering what she actually eats, what actually works, and honest takes on adaptation, results, and community questions. Popular for her livestreams and real-time Q&As.

Dr. Tony Hampton.bio: Family physician focused on reversing metabolic disease through low-carb and carnivore nutrition. Brings a clinical lens to everyday carnivore questions — especially around diabetes, obesity, and inflammation.

HomeSteadHow.bio: Homesteading meets carnivore — raising, processing, and eating real animal food. A grounding perspective for anyone who wants to understand where their food actually comes from.

Carnivore MD.bio: The channel that launched a thousand beef debates. Dr. Paul Saladino brought animal-based eating into the mainstream conversation and made organ meats cool again.

Maria Emmerich.bio: Bestselling cookbook author who's made low-carb and carnivore cooking genuinely delicious. If you've made a keto or carnivore recipe that actually tasted good, there's a decent chance it was hers.

Kristi Davis.bio: Documents her carnivore journey with a focus on combining strict carnivore eating with intermittent fasting protocols. Relatable, consistent, and great for people who want to see what the day-to-day actually looks like.

Dr. Eric Westman.bio: Duke University physician who has run clinical low-carb programs for over two decades. One of the most research-grounded voices in the keto and carnivore space.

Richard Smith.bio: One of the longer-running voices in the community with a focus on what actually happens after years on carnivore — not just the honeymoon phase. Covers carb reintroduction, sustainability, and the long game.
